criteria.criterion: When agent.review is copilot, `vloop doctor` and the run preflight check that copilot is on PATH and that `copilot --version` runs, as they do for claude: a missing or broken copilot is a problem (doctor exits 1; vloop run exits 1, says why and starts no session).
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor.go doctorCopilot uses driver.AgentPreflight and adds resProblem; TestDoctorCopilotMissingOrBroken covers missing, --version failing and preflight errors

criteria.criterion: When agent.review is copilot, `vloop doctor` prints `! agent.review is copilot: experimental — review sessions are not fenced until B20 (docs/guide/configuration.md)` and the run preflight prints the same `! …` line; it is a warning, not a problem: doctor exits 0 and the run goes on.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go copilotExperimental as resWarning; run.go prints '! name message' for it; TestDoctorCopilotFoundAndExperimental asserts exact line, exit 0 and nil preflight error

criteria.criterion: When agent.review is copilot and model.review comes from the default, `vloop run` prints `vloop: agent.review is copilot but model.review is the default "sonnet", a Claude alias: set model.review to a Copilot model id`, exits 1 and starts no session; a model.review set in the file or the environment is not refused.
criteria.evidence: run.go runPreflight returns Problem error when Source == SourceDefault; TestRunPreflightRefusesDefaultReviewModel asserts text and env-set acceptance; file-set case exercised in other tests with model.review = gpt-x

criteria.criterion: When agent.review is copilot, `vloop doctor` warns once for each directory in .claude/skills/ whose name ends in `review`, as `! .claude/skills/<name> may be loaded instead of /vloop:review by a copilot session` (exit 0); a skill whose name does not end in review gets no warning.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go loops over directories with HasSuffix review; TestDoctorCopilotSkillCollisions checks loop-review warned, reviewer not, exit 0

criteria.criterion: With every agent claude, doctor and the run need no copilot on PATH, print nothing about copilot (no skill-collision warning either) and behave exactly as before.
criteria.evidence: all new code is gated by copilotReview(root); TestDoctorAllClaudeSaysNothingOfCopilot asserts no copilot/skills output in doctor and preflight

criteria.criterion: docs/guide/configuration.md lists `copilot` among agent.review's valid values (and only claude for the other agent keys), has a row for copilot.credit-usd with default `0.0066667` and variable `VLOOP_COPILOT_CREDIT_USD`, and says that copilot review sessions are experimental until B20 and what C2's deny list stops (gh, push and remote changes, network commands, global git config, rm and forbidden git commands, web fetch, built-in MCP servers) and does not (anything not named, and other forms of the named commands).
criteria.evidence: configuration.md lines 33 and 36 (rows) plus the new paragraph at line 57 listing what the deny list stops and does not

criteria.criterion: Committed tests the checks run cover the copilot preflight (found, missing, --version failing), the experimental warning in doctor and the run, the default-model refusal (and its absence for a set model), the skill-collision warning, and their absence with every agent claude; a behaviour shipped with no such test is a violation.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor_copilot_test.go has five tests covering each listed case; go check passed per checks.json
